prov_test_1.text: How do I change my job categories and what is your website?

Hi Tatenda! To update your job categories, simply open the *side menu (☰)* or your *provider header* in the app and select *Account Settings*. You can manage up to 3 categories there at any time. Our official website is *https://finditharare.co.zw*. Let me know if you need help with anything else!

Hello *Tendai Moyo*! To top up your provider wallet, please send your USD payment via *EcoCash* to our official merchant number: *0713 475 131*. Once the transaction is complete, please copy and paste the *confirmation SMS* directly into the *Wallet tab* in your Findit Harare app.

cust_0793.text:
Hello *Mr Juice*! 👋 Welcome to *Findit Harare Official* Support (*finditharare.co.zw*).

Hello again, *Mr Juice*! 👋 How can I assist you with your *Findit Harare* experience today? Whether you need help booking a service, navigating the app, or have questions about our service categories, I'm here to help!

To top up your *Provider Wallet*, please follow these steps: 

1. Send your *USD* payment via *EcoCash* to our official merchant number: *0713 475 131*.
2. Once the transaction is complete, copy the *confirmation SMS* you receive from EcoCash.
3. Open the *Findit Harare* app, go to the *Wallet* tab, and paste the confirmation SMS there to credit your account.

*Important Note:* If your wallet balance is too low to bid, you must top up at least *$5.00* (or the 11% commission amount if it exceeds $5). Let me know if you need any further assistance, *Mr Juice*!

Hello *Mr Juice*! To track your service request in the *Findit Harare* app, simply open the app and navigate to your *Active Jobs* or *My Bookings* section. Once a provider accepts your request, you will see their status in real-time, including their location on the map as they head to your pinned address. If you have shared your *4-digit Start PIN* upon their arrival, you can monitor the progress of the job directly through the app interface. Let me know if you need help locating a specific booking!

I am very sorry to hear that, *Mr Juice*. Please rest assured that we take your safety and security very seriously at *Findit Harare Official*. Please also send a screenshot or details of the interaction to our official support line at *0713 475 131*. We will review the case and take the necessary action against the provider's account. Your safety is our priority.
